messages:
olivia-sales: Prospective customer 'BlueHarbor' requests BYO-KMS POC. Asks: automated KEK rotation demo, 72h pen-test window, perf proof for 9k QPS (p95 <130ms), and clear SOW language on key custody + rollback. Can we commit?
mark-se: We can run perf if they give traffic profile (avg seq len, burst). Rotation demo possible only if KEK remains in their HSM; we need wrapped test keys + thumbprint.
anya-crypto: Security constraints: no plaintext KEK export. Rotation handshake must be nonce-signed and include thumbprint verification (sha256 hex). Recommend one live rollover with 10min cutover, 30min grace.
kate-legal: I'll add SOW snippets: "No unencrypted key export", rotation rollback playbook, audit-log retention (1y), and pen-test liability cap (1x monthly SLA credit or $30k). Need named runbook owner for rollback.
sam-eng-ops: Perf slot: Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC. We can show 9k QPS for 10 mins with warmed caches if seq len <256. Need their allowlist for proxy IPs: 35.199.10.11/32 and 35.199.10.12/32. Sample thumbprint check:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms-proxy.redwood.example.com/thumbprint
```
Also prefer test keys wrapped by their KEK rather than live secrets for the POC.
olivia-sales: BlueHarbor insists on end-to-end with staging KEK. Compliance ok?
anya-crypto: Acceptable only if KEK is generated in their HSM and we receive wrapped keys + signed thumbprints. We'll record audit events for rotation (actor, timestamp, key-id).
kate-legal: Also include indemnity carveout for pen-tests limited to POC scope and cap damages to 2x monthly SLA credit. Add contact list for incident notifications.
mark-se: Pricing note: propose POC connector runtime $115/hr, optional onboarding $10k one-time (waivable for enterprise). I'll confirm with finance.
olivia-sales: Action items: 1) I'll propose Thu slot and request allowlist + wrapped test-key bundle, 2) Mark to confirm pricing, 3) Anya to draft rotation handshake spec, 4) Kate to draft SOW snippets, 5) Sam to reserve perf slot.
task-bot: task-created: byo-kms-3287654321 (owner=sam-eng-ops) due=3287740721
sam-eng-ops: Tentatively reserved Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC. Need wrapped-key bundle by Tue EOD to run preflight.
olivia-sales: Great, I'll ping BlueHarbor now and aim to send combined SOW + checklist + pricing by EOD. :thumbsup:
